jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included. You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time. You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits. Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>THE IDEAL CANDIDATE: </strong></span></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">We are looking for an exceptional Senior Manager, Global Procurement [Materials] to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices -done right. jobs.title: Revenue Operations Associate
jobs.description: Revenue Operations Associate Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Deine Mission Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln. trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen. Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen. Über trawa trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen. Das Team Unser Revenue-Operations-Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Es verbindet verschiedene Teams miteinander, schafft effiziente Prozesse und befähigt unseren Vertrieb, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Dadurch entsteht ein dynamisches Umfeld, das nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglicht. Deine Aufgaben Angebotserstellung (Configure-Price-Quote): Du verantwortest den Angebotsprozess und erstellst auf Basis von Kundendaten maßgeschneiderte Energiekonzepte – von passgenauen Stromversorgungsangeboten bis hin zu Batteriespeicherlösungen für die Industrie. Deal-Analyse und Pricing: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives und der Vertriebsleitung zusammen, um Deals ganzheitlich zu bewerten - dabei erkennst du Ausnahmen und Besonderheiten, weist auf sie hin und koordinierst die notwendigen Freigaben mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern. CRM & Deal-Management: Du verantwortest das Deal-Management in unserem CRM – einschließlich der Zuordnung von Deals in Deal-Phasen, der korrekten Erfassung von Produktkategorien und Umsätzen Vertragsmanagement: Du prüfst Verträge für unsere Großkund:innen und stellst sicher, dass unser Vertragswerk passgenau zu ihren Anforderungen passt. Vertriebsstrategie und Planung: Du unterstützt bei Pipeline-Reviews, Forecasts sowie bei der allgemeinen vertrieblichen Steuerung. Was du mitbringst Du denkst analytisch und arbeitest gerne mit Daten. Auffälligkeiten entgehen dir nicht – du gehst ihnen systematisch auf den Grund und identifizierst ihre Ursachen. Du gehst Probleme strukturiert und mit Neugier an. Auch bei einer zunächst unklaren Fragestellung findest du immer eine gute Lösung. Du kommunizierst schriftlich klar und präzise und arbeitest gerne mit internen Stakeholdern sowie Kund:innen und Vertriebspartnern zusammen. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Auge für Details. Ob ein fehlendes Datum oder eine uneinheitliche Definition einer Kennzahl – du erkennst solche Unstimmigkeiten bevor sie zum Problem werden. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System wie HubSpot oder Salesforce ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist, dass du bereit bist, dich schnell und gründlich in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people. Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality. What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI isn't a nice-to-have at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus. Deine Mission bei ]init[ Du möchtest digitale Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv gestalten und gemeinsam mit deinen Kund:innen weiterentwickeln? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) übernimmst du Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle digitale Kommunikationsprojekte – mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation und Content. Dabei verbindest du eine sichere Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte mit einem guten Gespür für die Bedarfe deiner Kund:innen. Du erkennst Entwicklungspotenziale, bringst die richtigen Expert:innen zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen erfolgreiche digitale Lösungen in der Umsetzung werden. Das gibt es zu tun Du steuerst anspruchsvolle digitale Umsetzungsprojekte und hältst Scope, Budget, Qualität und Timing sicher auf Kurs. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf digitalen Kommunikationsprojekten – insbesondere CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei arbeitest du mit Teams aus Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation, Content und UX zusammen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen und interdisziplinären Projektteams zusammen, verstehst Anforderungen und Herausforderungen und übersetzt sie in konkrete Projektziele und Lösungen. Für dich endet Projektmanagement nicht mit der erfolgreichen Delivery: Du erkennst neue Bedarfe und Potenziale bei bestehenden Kund:innen und entwickelst Projekte und Kundenbeziehungen gemeinsam mit unseren Fachexpert:innen weiter. Du bringst deine Erfahrung und Projektperspektive in Angebote, Ausschreibungen und Pitches ein. Wenn du hier bereits Erfahrung mitbringst, umso besser – wenn nicht, kannst du dich bei uns gezielt in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln. Du steuerst unterschiedliche Stakeholder souverän und sorgst auch in komplexen Projektsituationen für Klarheit, Verbindlichkeit und eine gute Zusammenarbeit. Das bringst du mit Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte – idealerweise rund um Websites, Informationsplattformen oder andere CMS-basierte Lösungen. Du verstehst Projektmanagement nicht als reine Verwaltung, sondern möchtest Projekte, Lösungen und Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln. Du hast Freude daran, Kund:innen und ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Potenziale zu erkennen und gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams passende Lösungen zu entwickeln. Du bist sowohl in der Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams als auch mit Disziplinen wie Kommunikation, UX, Design, Kreation oder Content sicher unterwegs. Erfahrung in Presales, Business Development, Ausschreibungen oder Angebotserstellung ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss. Ob agil oder klassisch: Du kennst unterschiedliche Projektmethoden und setzt sie passend zur jeweiligen Situation ein. Eine Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung aus Projekten im Public Sector oder in public-nahen Branchen mit. Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare praktische Qualifikation. Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit. Das bieten wir dir Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden. Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arb

jobs.title: Product Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Our Company "Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!" We're looking for a Product Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at Buying Labs ideally based in Hamburg or remotely for the right fit. In this role, you'll combine deep technical skill with strong product thinking to build tools and features using AI that create real value for our users and our business. You'll own features end to end - from scoping and design through development, deployment, and adoption - and use AI to build smarter and faster at every step. This is a role for builders who care about impact: people who understand both the user perspective and the underlying business processes, who can scope what needs to be built and then make it happen. Your Mission End-to-End Product Delivery: Own features from concept to production and real users, not just code -ship complete solutions that drive measurable business value. Scope requirements, define technical approaches, and deliver across frontend and backend, with quality built in from the start and verified through appropriate testing. Product Thinking & User Focus: Understand user needs and business processes to identify what should be built and why. Translate product ideas and stakeholder input into shipped experiences that users actually adopt. Building AI into Products: Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Identify opportunities where AI can speed up workflows, improve decision-making, or unlock new capabilities. Data Modelling & Scalable Systems: Build solid data models and scalable architectures that serve as a reliable foundation for our products. Turn repeated work into shared building blocks (UI components, data import flows, AI pipelines) so each new tool is faster to build than the last. Stakeholder Collaboration & Adoption: Work with stakeholders at all levels - from leadership to operations - to align on priorities and drive adoption of new tools and features. Communicate technical concepts clearly and build buy-in for your solutions across the organisation. Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback early, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build. Stay current with emerging technologies and engineering best practices to keep our tools & systems ahead of what the business needs to keep the platform competitive. Nice to Have: Experience with LLM tooling — provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality. Familiarity with vector search technologies (pgvector or similar). Hands-on experience with product analytics and observability tools (e.g. PostHog, Sentry) to measure usage and drive adoption. Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data). Background in eCommerce, wholesale, or B2B platform environments. Python for data tooling; Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS. Your Profile Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 5–8 years of professional experience in software development with a strong product mindset Strong experience with TypeScript and modern React. Backend experience with Node.js, Express or comparable, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL with practical SQL. For mostly building new applications on our modern stack (React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Bun) and occasionally working in an established JavaScript codebase. Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks and agentic AI systems and solid skills in data modelling and building scalable system architectures. Comfort operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. jobs.title: Working Student Global Licensing (DACH) (all genders)
jobs.description: Über tonies: tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat die Art und Weise, wie kleine Kinder unabhängig spielen und lernen, durch seinen kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz verändert. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert, und das Portfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Seit der Gründung hat tonies bedeutende Meilensteine erreicht, darunter die Börsennotierung an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im November 2021 sowie ein global aufgestelltes Team von über 550 engagierten Experten, die aus verschiedenen Ländern agieren. Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, an einer inspirierenden Mission mitzuwirken: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie. Du als Teil von tonies: Bei Tonies Licensing haben wir es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die Magie von Audio zu Kindern überall auf der Welt zu bringen. Wir suchen eine motivierte und begeisterte Studentische Nachwuchskraft (m/w/d), die unser Portfolio an globalen Lizenzkonten unterstützt und dabei hilft, internationale Lizenzprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Produktlaunch voranzutreiben. Diese Rolle ist perfekt für jemanden, der wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in einem kommerziell ausgerichteten Umfeld sammeln möchte – an der Seite eines Teams, das Beziehungen zu großen internationalen Lizenzgebern der Spielzeug- und Unterhaltungsbranche in Nordamerika und der EMEA-Region betreut. Deine Aufgaben umfassen: Unterstützung im Lizenzmanagement: Du unterstützt das Lizenz-Team bei der Pflege und Koordination der Beziehungen zu internationalen Lizenzpartnern. Mitarbeit an internationalen Projekten: Du begleitest internationale Lizenzprojekte über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von den ersten Gesprächen über den Vertragsabschluss bis hin zur Produktentwicklung und dem Marktstart. Kaufmännische Unterstützung: Du hilfst bei der Erstellung und Pflege von Lizenz-GuVs (Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen) und unterstützt bei der Ausarbeitung von Berichten sowie Präsentationen für interne Stakeholder. Schnittstellenkoordination: Du unterstützt die Kommunikation zwischen internen Fachbereichen (z. B. Produktentwicklung, Marketing, Recht, Finanzen) und externen Lizenzagenturen oder -partnern. Markt- & Branchenrecherche: Du recherchierst aktuelle Trends sowie Entwicklungen in der globalen Lizenz- und Unterhaltungsbranche und bereitest die Ergebnisse für das Team auf. Was wir uns von dir wünschen: Studium: Immatrikulierte/r Student/in, idealerweise in Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL), Medienmanagement, Kommunikationswissenschaften oder einem verwandten Studiengang. Brancheninteresse: Erste Berührungspunkte mit oder Interesse an der globalen Spielzeug- und Unterhaltungsindustrie. Zahlenaffinität: Grundlegendes Verständnis kaufmännischer Konzepte sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit Excel und Berichten. Vorerfahrung von Vorteil: Praktika oder Tätigkeiten als Werkstudent/in im Bereich Lizenzierung, Marketing oder Business Development sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Kommunikationsstärke: Gute Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch sowie ein selbstsicheres Auftreten im Kontakt mit externen Partnern. Persönlichkeit: Proaktive, strukturierte und lernbegierige Persönlichkeit, die gerne eigenverantwortlich arbeitet und sich in einem internationalen, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlt. Warum tonies? Globales Teamwork: Wir arbeiten über Abteilungs- und Ländergrenzen hinweg an unserer Vision, die Toniebox in jedes Kinderzimmer der Welt zu bringen. Come as you are: Das gilt nicht nur für den Dresscode, sondern für alles andere auch. Denn nur wo du dich wirklich wohlfühlst, kannst du dein Bestes geben. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Experience Above the Box (all genders)
jobs.description: About tonies: tonies is the globally leading interactive audio platform for children with more than 10 million Tonieboxes and 125 million Tonies sold. The intuitive and award-winning audio system has changed the way young children play and learn independently with its child-safe, wireless, and screen-free approach. Tonieboxes have been activated in over 100 countries, the content portfolio includes around 1,400 Tonies in several languages. Since its inception, tonies has achieved significant milestones, including listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in November 2021 as well as a globally present team of over 550 dedicated professionals operating from various countries. Joining our tonies team means being part of an inspiring mission to create innovative and meaningful experiences for children around the world. Together, we’re shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination. You as part of tonies: Above the box is where the magic of tonies becomes tangible: the Tonies themselves — Content, Creative, Clever — and Tonieplay. As Engineering Manager (all genders) for our Above-the-Box value stream, you lead a cross-functional team that owns these experiences end to end — from the device through App and cloud, across every Toniebox generation and every device our products will run on next. Together with your Product Manager, you shape both the experiences we ship and the team that builds them, bringing joy to millions of children worldwide. jobs.description: About us We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets. A day in the life As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on. This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets. Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration. We embrace modern development practices: All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience. We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day. We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start. As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.   Your responsibilities ü  Build and maintain secure platform foundations Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on. Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable. Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it. Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads. ü  Make our security controls provable Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements. Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort. Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved. Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling. ü  Strengthen access and identity controls Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege. Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities. Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review. ü  Extend our platform standards beyond AWS Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate. jobs.description: TL;DR - Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. Biased toward shipping and iterating on messaging quickly over lengthy planning cycles. What we’re looking for 6+ years of experience in product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or content/messaging roles. Experience at a high tech company. Preferred: Experience working alongside lifecycle or CRM tools such as Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io , even if you weren't the one operating them. Familiarity with growth metrics and experimentation frameworks (PQLs, activation rate, feature adoption) enough to speak the same language as a Growth PM. Experience working with developer, startup, or solo builder audiences. Experience building messaging frameworks or toolkits that scaled across multiple teams. jobs.title: QA Lead
jobs.description: About Foundation Health Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy. We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other. The Role You'd be joining alongside our QA Lead in the US, with real ownership of building this out properly in the UK: strategy, tooling, standards, process — all still very much taking shape. There's no hands-off management here — everybody, at every level, is hands-on, and that includes you. And because we're AI-native by design, testing here isn't testing conventional software. You'll be leading the charge on how we test AI-led products across the UK — agentic workflows, LLM-based features, non-deterministic behaviour that doesn't fit a traditional pass/fail script. What you'll actually do: Build out our QA function properly: strategy, process, tooling and standards, working alongside our US QA Lead as we grow this on both sides of the Atlantic Design and own testing for AI-driven features: agentic workflows, LLM outputs, evaluation frameworks, and the genuinely hard question of what "correct" even means when a system doesn't behave the same way twice Get hands-on with automation using Playwright and TypeScript — and just as hands-on with manual testing, regression and UAT when that's what a release actually needs. This isn't a role where you delegate the manual work away Set the bar for how quality gets handled company-wide as we scale — not just catching bugs, but building the culture that prevents them Work closely with Engineering and Product to make sure quality is part of how things get built, not a gate bolted on at the end Who thrives here? Builders, not inheritors. You've either grown a QA function from something small before, or you've been desperate for the chance to. Coming into an established, fully-formed process isn't what excites you — shaping something still taking form is. Genuinely fluent in AI, not just aware of it. AI is already part of your day-to-day — you use it properly, and you're curious about pushing it further. And on the testing side, you've either tested AI-led products already or you understand exactly why testing them is a different problem to testing normal software. True hybrids, with zero ego about it. You're as comfortable writing a Playwright suite in TypeScript as you are doing hands-on manual testing, regression and UAT. Nobody here delegates the "unglamorous" work away — including you. Strong technical fundamentals underneath the modern tooling. Test strategy, defect management, release process — the fundamentals are solid, even if the problems you're applying them to are new. People who lead by doing. This role grows into shaping and leading QA in the UK as we scale. But there's no hands-off management track here — whoever's in this role is still testing, still in the detail, still building alongside the team, at every stage of growth. jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer ( London)
jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. Our Customer Success team — The Heartbeat of Deepgram — sits at the intersection of customers, product, and growth. We don't just "manage accounts." We make Deepgram succeed inside our customers' environments by combining deep technical expertise, commercial instinct, and an AI-native way of working — and by building the systems that make the whole team's work compound over time. jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence. In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes. Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander) Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update Interface & System Specifications Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering Produce interface control documents (ICDs), system description documents (SDDs), and integration guides for system integrators and institutional clients Translate engineering schematics, API references, and architecture diagrams into human-readable specifications accessible to non-specialist audiences Maintain up-to-date configuration guides, parameter references, and software release notes for each product version Support the Engineering team in documenting internal technical standards and development guidelines Operational & Field Documentation Develop field-ready documentation adapted to operational environments: laminated quick-reference cards, checklists, and compact field guides Produce pre-flight checklists, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting guides for UAV platforms and C-UAS systems Create training materials and operational scenario guides for use during client onboarding, field demonstrations, and exercises Ensure all field documentation meets the usability requirements of military audiences: clear hierarchy, unambiguous language, and actionable step-by-step instructions Documentation Lifecycle & Quality Management Own the documentation lifecycle end-to-end: planning, drafting, review, validation, versioning, and publication Establish and enforce documentation standards across Alta Ares: style guide, terminology glossary, formatting conventions, and review processes Coordinate review cycles with Engineeri

jobs.title: Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer – Interceptor Drones
jobs.description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. About the Role We are building next-generation interceptor drones and are looking for a Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer to lead the development of small-scale jet propulsion systems (12–25 kg thrust class), from concept to flight-ready hardware. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role in a fast-moving startup environment where speed and iteration matter more than lengthy upfront studies. Responsibilities: Design and develop new small jet engines (12–25 kg thrust range) in-house, optimized for very low production cost Own the aerodynamic design of turbine components, balancing performance, manufacturability, and cost Design a large portion of the turbine for metal 3D printing (additive manufacturing), leveraging design-for-AM principles to reduce part count, weight, and cost Work closely with 3D printing operations to define printable geometries, tolerances, post-processing, and qualify parts for flight use Drive a rapid, fail-fast iteration process: build, test, learn, and redesign quickly rather than relying on long analytical phases before prototyping Integrate propulsion systems into airframes such as flying wings and other interceptor drone configurations, working with aerostructures and systems teams Apply and enforce design rules for operation in extreme environments (cold and hot climates, rain, humidity, icing conditions) to ensure engine reliability across the full operational envelope Contribute to engine testing (bench and flight), performance validation, and continuous design improvement Candidate Profile: Minimum 8 years of experience in jet engine / gas turbine design, with a proven track record of having designed and delivered engine models (not just component-level work) Strong hands-on experience with small jet engines in the 12–25 kg thrust class Solid global understanding of jet engine architecture: compressor, combustor, turbine, fuel system, controls, and their interactions Experience designing turbine/engine components for metal additive manufacturing (DfAM), and practical knowledge of metal 3D printing processes and constraints Comfortable working in a rapid-iteration, fail-fast development culture rather than a traditional long-cycle aerospace process Experience integrating propulsion systems into airframes (flying wing or similar unconventional platforms is a strong plus) Knowledge of design requirements for extreme operating environments (temperature extremes, precipitation, icing) Ability to work autonomously in a small, fast-paced startup team, wearing multiple hats when needed Nice to Have Experience with UAV/drone propulsion specifically (vs. manned aviation) Familiarity with low-cost manufacturing strategies for defense/dual-use hardware Prior startup or jobs.description: TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm. About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The Role You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically. You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself. What you will be working on Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable. Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data. Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage. Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining. Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture. Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time. What We Are Looking For You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you. Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself. Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation. Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture. Ni

jobs.title: PhD - Inverse modal identification of free-field radiated noise from unducted rotor-stator stages: from laboratory arrays to Open Fan flight tests
jobs.description: Context: This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines’ RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (École Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources. Objective: To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size). Description: Task 1 – Model and inverse problem. Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations. Task 2 – Validation on the MAMBO database. The developments will be tested on an unducted propeller + stator configuration recently studied at LMFA (MAMBO project), instrumented with three arrays: a half-cylindrical array, a planar array on the side (representative of fuselage instrumentation) and a motorised arc array measuring directivity, which will serve as an independent reference. This study will assess the robustness of the method and define array design criteria. Task 3 – Application to flight tests. The methodology will be applied to the near-field pressure data acquired on the fuselage during the TAKE-OFF flight test campaigns, in order to identify the modal content of the noise radiated by the Open Fan engine and to infer information on its generation mechanisms. Starting date : 01/01/2027 Profile and application: PhD in acoustics, aeroacoustics or signal processing; skills in array methods, inverse problems and/or modal analysis; scientific programming (Python/Matlab). References: [1] Pereira, A. & Jacob, M.C., 2022, Modal analysis of in-duct fan broadband noise via an iterative Bayesian inverse approach, J. Sound Vib. , doi:10.1016/j.jsv.2021.116633. [2] Roger, M. & Kucukcoskun, K., 2019, Near-and-far field modeling of advanced tail-rotor noise using source-mode expansions, J. Sound Vib. , 453, 328-354. LMFA contacts: Antonio Pereira, Marc Jacob LVA contact: Quentin Leclère (LVA, INSA Lyon) Funding: European project TAKE-OFF (Technology and Knowledge for European Open Fan Flight) Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (JetBrains Context)
jobs.description: <p>Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. We want to create delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, helping to improve the industry by elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology. We’re on a mission to revolutionise the property industry, and our Product team is at the heart of that mission identifying the most valuable problems to solve, guiding teams to ship high-quality solutions, and measuring the impact along the way. If you’re looking for the chance to take real ownership of your product area in a collaborative, transparent and values-driven culture, we’d love to hear from you. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Product Manager within our Cortex Product at Street Group, you’ll be a trusted leader in your area of responsibility. This is a high-autonomy role with ownership from day one, combining digital, marketing and AI initiatives. You will: Own the strategy, roadmap and outcomes for within Cortex Support alignment across other teams for approximately 12 months while leading your own product areas Shape and deliver our AI-driven strategy, including AI workflows and wider PropTech AI integration Lead discovery directly with customers, turning insight into clear, actionable priorities Influence senior stakeholders across engineering, design, data and leadership to gain buy-in and drive execution Act as a role model for independent decision-making, coaching others and contributing to best practice What success looks like in this role You’ll thrive here if you can: Take ambiguous problems and turn them into clear product priorities Balance customer needs, commercial outcomes and technical feasibility Work with a high degree of autonomy, without needing step-by-step direction Bring clarity, pace and strong judgement across multiple digital and AI initiatives Help teams focus on the highest-value opportunities and measure the impact A bit about you We’re looking for someone who can hit the ground running and operate at Senior PM level from day one. Essential experience: Proven experience in B2B or SaaS product strategy, with end-to-end ownership and clear commercial impact Strong stakeholder management skills, able to influence across departments and levels Confidence working autonomously in a fast-moving environment Experience using and integrating AI tools into your day-to-day product management workflow (e.g. Claude Code and similar) Clear, articulate communication and be able to explain what you built, why you built it, and the results it achieved Passion for product, motivation to improve processes, and curiosity to keep learning You’ll likely be a strong fit if you are: Strategic, but still happy to be hands-on with discovery and delivery Comfortable owning both customer-facing digital products and internal AI/productivity initiatives Motivated by high ownership, high trust and high standards Excited by the opportunity to work in PropTech, helping improve an entire industry through software Why join Street Group? 🏠 Hybrid-working, you can work from home up to 3 days per week 🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description: 📍Manchester 💰 £28k-£30k + uncapped commission (OTE £45k) Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology. If you join us, you’ll be helping to improve the property industry for everyone by widening the reach of our products and introducing them to Estate Agents across the UK; in turn making agents more successful and helping them deliver an incredible customer experience. We'll support you with structured training, a competitive commission structure, and an open and inclusive environment. If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in! A bit about you… You'll have previous outbound sales experience in a B2B setting You’ll have experience delivering on set monthly KPI’s/targets. You’re self motivated, with a proactive attitude towards working to targets, with a tenacious nature and a strong desire to succeed. You’re a self-starter who can take initiative when needed and isn’t afraid to pick up the phone and make contact with potential new clients. You’re curious and conscientious, you’ll make it your business to know everything about our product and have the communication skills to share that knowledge in a way that inspires. Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. If you are resilient, hard-working, and want to earn a ton of money - we'd love to see your application! Here’s what you can expect to be working on as a Sales Development Representative at Street Group Supporting the wider Sales, Customer Success and Marketing teams to identify and engage new business opportunities. Connecting with prospective customers through conducting engaging outbound calls, crafting compelling emails and connecting with them on other platforms. Immersing yourself in the company and sharing your informed passion for our evolving product. Identifying, building and nurturing a pipeline of self-generated client prospects. Working collaboratively with your team and the wider group to ensure high performance. Collaboration is what we do best! Ensuring our customers have a first-class experience at every opportunity. Who are Street Group? We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone. Back in 2015, our co-Founder, Tom Staff, spent his evenings building Spectre v1.0. He’d seen first-hand an opportunity to automate the very manual process of winning new business for estate agents. Spectre is now our multi award-winning, instruction generation tool, generating an average return on investment for them of over 3000%. Street.co.uk then launched back in 2020 and serves as our game-changing CRM, allowing agents to deliver a service that aligns seamlessly with the modern, 'on-demand' needs of customers and their busy lifestyles. Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK. Why join Street Group? 🏠Competitive salary + uncapped commission 💃 Paid quarterly team nights out 💸 Weekly + monthly incentives 🍽️ Top performers dinners 🏖

jobs.title: Product Manager - Compliance
jobs.description: Product Manager – Compliance Help Shape the Future of AI Compliance in Financial Services Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers, and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. Recognized as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025, we are backed by leading investors and supported by major financial institutions as we scale rapidly amid accelerating AI adoption in financial services. Our platform enables some of the UK’s largest financial institutions to deploy AI safely in FCA-regulated environments, powering everything from compliance monitoring to AI-driven adviser guidance. We are seeking a Product Manager – Assurance to play a central role in Aveni’s Assurance portfolio: products that help financial services firms govern, test, and assure AI agents and human interactions across the customer journey. The Role This role is primarily focused on Agent Approve, Aveni’s pre-deployment simulation and testing product, with additional responsibility for Detect, our post-interaction compliance assessment product. Agent Approve is a growth-stage product operating in a dynamic regulatory environment. You will own the product from discovery through commercial readiness, helping define Aveni’s position in an emerging market. This is a hands-on, high-ownership product role. You will collaborate closely with the Head of Assurance Products on strategy and roadmap direction while independently driving discovery, prioritisation, delivery, and go-to-market readiness. You will work with engineering, design, customer success, marketing, and commercial teams to turn complex customer and regulatory problems into clear, valuable, and shippable product outcomes. You are well suited to this role if you enjoy operating in ambiguity, can bring structure to complex problem spaces, and possess the judgement to prioritize effectively, distinguishing what matters, what can wait, and what needs validation before building. What You’ll Be Doing Own the Agent Approve and Detect product roadmaps from problem discovery and opportunity sizing through prioritisation, delivery, and launch readiness. The observation product captures metadata everywhere it is generated and maps it into a knowledge graph, so every run carries full provenance. jobs.description: The opportunity Substrate is building the molecular characterisation cascade that turns purified protein into trustworthy, quality-controlled, biophysically characterised data at scale, and you will build it from the first manual run. This is the work downstream of protein production and upstream of functional assays: quality control, binding, stability, and developability, developed by hand and engineered to move onto automation. The data this cascade produces is the product. Substrate is the critical infrastructure layer between AI and biology, and biological foundation models can predict but cannot experiment; the high-quality, large-scale data they need does not exist yet. About Substrate Substrate is building the critical infrastructure layer between AI and biology: an AI-native automated lab that produces biological data at scale. AI for biology has a data problem, not a compute problem. Biological foundation models can predict, but they cannot run experiments, and the high-quality, large-scale data they need does not exist. Substrate generates it, with quality and provenance built in. The role You will build the molecular characterisation cascade that sits downstream of protein production and upstream of functional assays: the biophysical, analytical, and developability assays that decide what each molecule is and whether it holds up. The cascade will eventually run autonomously on Substrate’s automation platform. In the first phase, you develop each assay by hand, running protocols manually, setting reproducibility and quality thresholds, and proving each assay out before it moves onto instrumentation. As the automation platform comes online, the work shifts toward instrumented execution, equivalence validation, and the engineering judgement calls that decide which manual steps get automated and which stay in human hands. Every level works directly with the automation engineering and software teams on the boundary between scientific protocols and autonomous execution. Lab Technicians are the hands-on execution layer: following established SOPs, preparing reagents and consumables, maintaining equipment, and running routine steps of validated protocols so that Scientists and Principal Scientists can focus on design and troubleshooting. Help interview the scientists and lab technicians joining alongside you. jobs.title: Expression of Interest - Internships
jobs.description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Internship - Expression of Interest We're always interested in hearing from exceptional students who want to work on the hardest problems in AI infrastructure - bringing novel accelerators to life, building the systems that orchestrate them, and charting the new territories of what heterogeneous compute can do. There's no formal internship programme or fixed cycle here - internships happen when the need and the right person come together. This form is how we keep track of who to reach out to when that happens. If you think you have unique skills to contribute, or are studying or have experience in any of the following, we'd love to hear from you: High-performance systems and low-level performance engineering Inference infrastructure, orchestration, or distributed systems Hardware bring-up, kernel development, or accelerator programming Simulation, modelling, or workload design This is a general interest form rather than an application for a specific internship. We review all submissions on an ongoing basis and will reach out when we see a strong match and the right opportunity comes up. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure. Arctic Research and Development (ARD) was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox—an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence—is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. THE ROLE We're looking for a Perception Engineer to build the eyes for autonomous systems operating in the world's most sensor-hostile environment. You'll develop computer vision and sensor fusion systems that cut through Arctic whiteout, polar night darkness, and ice fog — where traditional perception stacks fail. jobs.title: Knit - Research Manager
jobs.description: Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible. Overview The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention. Responsibilities: The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business. The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are: Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s) Primary responsibilities of this role: Serving as the dedicated research lead for all customers’ projects (on assigned accounts) and serving as the ultimate accountable part for research project success Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success Demonstrate a growth mindset as a solutions architect for customers, educating them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success - escalating to Research Directors when needs exceed capabilities Escalating needs to Research Directors to support troubleshooting when increased risk for project viability or customer impact occurs Driving, maintaining, and enriching all customer context to improve Knit’s ability to meet the customers’ custom research needs Being the final, customer-ready check and approver on all Knit final topline delivery and presenting the key insights and recommendations directly to the customers Participating in continuous innovation on Knit’s AI product to minimize the delta between Knit’s AI output and a human researcher output Driving on feedback collection on “the last mile” - uncovering and documenting what happens after Knit delivers a project to when it’s “stakeholder ready,” supporting Knit’s product vision in getting to stakeholder ready reports Required Skills & Experiences: Must have 5+ years of market research experience, with the majority of the time spent on the supplier side in a market research agency environment. Must have experience leading discovery and scoping calls, writing and editing quant and qual questionnaires from scratch, drafting analysis plans, and creating and presenting stakeholder-ready insights topline & reports. Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes in ambiguous environments, both for navigating complex customer needs and Knit internal business changes. Proven track record successfully operating in an early stage startup (<50 employees) is a plus. Proven track record of owning and supporting client relationships with customers at Enterprise, Fortune 500 US-based companies, specifically working with insights professionals to scope and achieve desired research outcomes, resulting in customer retention and growth. jobs.title: CDI - MODELISTE FLOU ET/OU TAILLEUR (H/F)
jobs.description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS   Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.   Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).   Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).   VOTRE ROLE En lien direct avec le studio de création, vous traduisez les croquis et les intentions du directeur artistique en volumes et en premiers patronages. Vous êtes garant(e) de la silhouette, des proportions et du bien-aller des pièces de la Maison.   VOS MISSIONS Interpréter les croquis et les références du studio pour créer les patronages Travailler les volumes en coupe à plat et en moulage Réaliser et modifier les toiles Suivre le montage des prototypes avec l'atelier Animer les essayages et proposer des ajustements de coupe et de proportions Faire évoluer les patronages jusqu'à la validation finale Transmettre au bureau d'études des modèles et des dossiers techniques complets   VOTRE PROFIL Formation en modélisme (BTS, DMA, ESMOD, AICP, Chambre Syndicale ou équivalent) 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en tant que modéliste dans une maison de luxe ou de prêt-à-porter haut de gamme Spécialisation flou et/ou tailleur, avec une bonne connaissance des matières associées (soie, crêpe, lainages, tissus structurés…) Maîtrise de la coupe à plat et du moulage ; la connaissance d'un logiciel de CAO est un plus Sensibilité créative et bonne compréhension de l'univers de la Maison Sens du volume, du détail et du bien-aller Capacité à échanger avec le studio et à tenir les délais de collection   Ce poste est basé dans le 8ème arrondissement de Paris Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
