jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Hospitals
jobs.description: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care. We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the Role We’re looking for an Senior Account Executive to grow our footprint across France. You’ll be at the forefront of introducing Tandem’s clinician copilot to providers, partners, and health systems - shaping how we scale across France This is a pivotal role where you’ll forge high-impact partnerships across the care ecosystem, from provider networks and EHR vendors to resellers and health insurers. You’ll act as a market expert, relationship builder, and operator all in one. What you will do Identify, initiate, and manage key relationships across the healthcare landscape in France. Open doors with provider groups, EHR vendors, system integrators, payors, and commercial resellers to accelerate Tandem’s reach and adoption. Pitch, negotiate, and close deals that deliver strategic value, working closely with legal, product, and commercial teams to get contracts across the line. Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner. Bring the voice of the market back into Tandem, sharing insights that inform product development, regulatory priorities, and local go-to-market strategy. Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem. What You Bring Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies. Deep knowledge of the French hospital ecosystem - from payors and providers to health IT vendors and regional nuances. A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups. Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations. Fluent in French and English, with excellent communication skills. Independent operator with the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams. Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation. Bonus Points Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms. Background in medtech, digital health, healthcare Familiarity with EU/French regulatory and compliance environments. Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets. What we offer Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options 30 days of holiday Paid parental leave €1,000 annual health & wellbeing budget, plus mental-health support whenever you need it A real learning budget and internal growth paths - build your career without leaving Tandem Fully AI native company - let our agents do the grunt work Two company off-sites a year, plus a team budget for the things that bring you closer State of the art office in the heart of Paris, and your choice of IT equipment Location We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Paris, France. You’ll travel regularly - either to meet clinicians around France or to collaborate with our team in Stockholm. How to Apply We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English. Our interview process consists of 4 stages: Screening interview with Talent Acquisition First interview with our Country Director in France

jobs.title: Founding Customer Training Manager - France (m/f/d)
jobs.description: 🎤 Why voize? Because we're more than just a job! At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people . Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact. Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital , with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload. 💡 Your Mission: Own the training experience for users in France As our Founding Customer Training Manager , you will be responsible for establishing and scaling the training program for our expansion into France. You'll inherit a proven methodology from the German market and adapt it for French healthcare facilities. You will motivate and engage groups of 10-15 caregivers, empowering them to embrace the technology and improve their documentation workflow. 🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike Lead in-person training sessions for new customer deployments, training groups of healthcare providers in French-speaking regions. Refine training materials and playbooks for the French market and for individual customers as needed. Travel to customer sites (estimated 2-3 weeks per month, depending on deployment schedule) to deliver on-site training and support go-live activities across France. Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Success, Product, and our German training team to optimize training approach and share insights. Measure and report on training effectiveness , using adoption metrics and feedback to continuously improve our approach. Ensure compliance with French healthcare regulations and documentation requirements (GDPR, standards, etc.). 🤝 Your Skillset - What you bring to the table 3+ years in training, onboarding, or customer enablement in B2B, ideally healthcare or another technical environment - and you have built a program from scratch, not just delivered one Proven track record designing and delivering in-person training to non-technical and mixed-ability audiences Business fluent level of French (C2 or bilingual) including regional and cultural nuance, plus working English for the international team You use adoption metrics and feedback to sharpen your approach, and you can work around legacy EHRs and limited IT infrastructure 🌱 Growing together – what you can expect at voize Become a co-creator of our success with virtual stock options. France-based opportunity. Work from anywhere in France (travel to customer sites as needed). We have bases in Berlin and are expanding into France. Flexible working hours because you know best when you work most efficiently. Open culture with regular team collaboration and learning opportunities. You'll work on the founding team for a high-growth function - significant opportunity for impact and rapid growth. Your work will make a real impact, helping alleviate workload for healthcare professionals and improving care documentation quality. jobs.title: Contrôleur de gestion & Data analyste
jobs.description: NOTRE ONG :                Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence avec ses plus de 3500 collaborateurs.   Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux premiers entretiens. CONTEXTE : Vous intégrez le Service Contrôle de gestion Siège et Associations Nationales (AN) , dont le rôle est d'accompagner les directions et associations nationales dans le pilotage financier, budgétaire et analytique de leurs activités. Il assure la production des reportings financiers, la consolidation des données du réseau, le suivi des risques financiers et l'amélioration continue des outils et processus de gestion. Votre future équipe est constituée de 8 collaborateurs (7 à Lyon, 1 au Luxembourg), avec un périmètre international stimulant (interactions avec les États-Unis et l'Allemagne). Cette articulation vise à renforcer la qualité de l'information, l'automatisation des reportings et l'aide à la décision. L’objectif est de structurer, fiabiliser, analyser et mettre à disposition les données utiles au pilotage, tout en assurant le suivi budgétaire, financier et des risques du périmètre confié. Le poste transforme les besoins métiers en indicateurs et tableaux de bord exploitables, accompagne les responsables budgétaires et contribue à l'amélioration continue des processus et systèmes d'information financiers. Ce poste permet de transformer les données complexes en véritables outils d'aide à la décision ! Requirements Votre parcours & vos expériences Formation : Diplômé(e) d'une école de commerce, d'une école d'ingénieur ou titulaire d'un Master 2 en gestion/finance. Expériences : Une solide pratique confirmée en data analyse, contrôle de gestion, reporting financier ou sur une fonction hybride finance/data. Une première expérience ou des interactions régulières avec un organe de direction type conseil d'administration serait un plus. Vos compétences techniques Maîtrise des outils : Niveau avancé sur Excel et sur un outil de data visualisation (Power BI idéalement). Data & Process : Capacité à structurer les données, formaliser des règles de gestion, automatiser les reportings et comprendre les environnements ERP, Data Warehouse et la gouvernance des données. Finance : Maîtrise solide du contrôle budgétaire, de l'analyse d'écarts, des clôtures et des réconciliations. Un plus apprécié : Connaissance de Navision, Workday, SQL ou d'outils équivalents. Vos savoir-être Rigueur & Fiabilité : Grand sens de la qualité et de l'organisation, avec une excellente gestion des priorités. Esprit d'analyse : Capacité à synthétiser, vulgariser et proposer des améliorations continues orientées solutions. jobs.title: Ingénieur R&D logiciel F/H
jobs.description: L’Université de technologie de Compiègne recrute un(e) ingénieur(e) R&D logiciel pour le laboratoire Biomécanique et Bioingénierie (BMBI) au sein du département Génie Biologique (GB). Ce recrutement intervient dans le cadre du projet de maturation CHRONOS soutenu par la SATT LUCTECH. Votre mission Contribuer activement à la conception logicielle d'un prototype innovant de mesure et de traitement de signaux HD-sEMG (électromyographie de surface haute densité). En tant qu’acteur/actrice clé du projet, vous serez engagé(e) dans un processus complet de création de « briques » technologiques : spécifications, programmation, caractérisation et qualifications expérimentales jusqu’aux tests de fiabilité en environnement réel. Vos activités Développement logiciel : concevoir et coder l'architecture logicielle (traitement des données de signaux complexes, communication entre dispositifs, développement de l'interface homme-machine (IHM)). Phase de Test & Validation : designer, planifier et suivre les phases de tests hardware/software du dispositif d’acquisition HD-sEMG en environnement réaliste. Recueil de données : participer activement aux campagnes de mesures expérimentales Gestion de projet : assurer le suivi des livrables en lien avec les exigences de la SATT Lutech et documenter les développements. Veille technologique : rester en alerte sur les nouveautés scientifiques et techniques afin d'optimiser le prototype. Contexte du projet Issu d’une collaboration entre l’UTC, Sorbonne Université et l’AP-HP, CHRONOS répond à un enjeu clinique fort : permettre une évaluation simple, rapide et précise des capacités musculaires grâce aux signaux HD-sEMG. Cette innovation ouvre de nouvelles perspectives pour le suivi de la récupération fonctionnelle, la détection précoce de la sarcopénie et l’évaluation de la performance en santé et en médecine du sport. La SATT LUTECH accompagne ce projet en finançant le développement d’un premier prototype pour accélérer sa maturation et préparer son transfert. Ce projet fait suite à plusieurs projets de recherche financés par : EIT Health, Mécénat des mutuelles AXA, Fondation de l’Avenir, AP-HP, ANR France relance 2030, UTC, IUIS SU. jobs.title: Ingénieur de recherche F/H Détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes par apprentissage très faiblement supervisé : Etudes, applications et transposition des méthodes Visual Large Model à l’industrie du futur.
jobs.description: Ce recrutement s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet PostGenAI piloté par Sorbonne Université. Le projet est soutenu par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche ( ANR ), dans le cadre du plan d'investissement gouvernemental  France 2030 . Vos missions Assurer une étude scientifique rigoureuse, visant à comparer les performances des modèles VLM sur la détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes. Prendre en charge l’étude complète, dimensionner les critères d’évaluations ainsi que les configurations de déploiement des modèles, mener les expérimentations associées. Contribuer à l’écriture d’articles scientifiques reprenant les résultats de l’étude et proposant des recommandations quant à la transposition et au déploiement des modèles VLM dans l’industrie. Activités principales Le sujet traite de la problématique générale de la détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes dans l’industrie. L’industrie doit se doter d’outils d’inspection de confiance rapidement déployables en production. Les solutions d’IA supervisées les plus performantes reposent sur une activité préalable longue et coûteuses d’étiquetage d’images par des experts-process (plusieurs centaines d’étiquetages d’images). Les anomalies visuelles complexes sont : (1) des défauts logiques où les modèles doivent détecter et contrôler la logique de positionnement relatif entre différents objets ou entités de la scène. Il s’agit par exemple : du contrôle de l’absence/présence de pièces ou composants, de la détection d’erreurs de câblages etc. (2), ils sont aussi des défauts de texture, comme des opacités, des fissures, des arrachements, etc. L’activité principale du poste sera d’étudier puis de comparer les performances des modèles VLM sur la détection de ces anomalies. Les critères de couts seront pris en comptes (liés à l’inférence, à l’étiquetage, aux formulations des prompts et à la consommation électrique, etc). Les différents types de modèles (format ouvert, propriétaire etc.) seront à considérer pour l’étude.  Sur la base des résultats obtenus, des recommandations quant à la transposition de ces méthodes à l’industrie seront proposées puis valorisées auprès d’industriels partenaires de l’UTC. La rédaction, la soumission et la publication dans des journaux scientifiques sont attendues. Informations complémentaires Dates pour candidater Du 21/09/2026 au 20/10/2026 Type de contrat et date prévisionnelle de recrutement Contrat à durée déterminée - durée prévue de 18 mois - à pourvoir en octobre 2026 Salaire mensuel brut Selon expérience et financement Volume horaire 37 heures et 30 minutes par semaine - 1 607 heures par an Contexte scientifique / résumé du projet Le cluster PostGenAI@Paris a pour ambition d’anticiper les ruptures de l’intelligence artificielle et d’en maîtriser les enjeux scientifiques, sociétaux et éthiques — là où les frontières entre technologie et intelligence humaine deviennent progressivement indistinctes. https://postgenai.sorbonne-universite.fr Le projet porte sur le CAP 1.6 AI for Industry, qui a pour objectif de développer des méthodes d’explicabilité et de quantification d’incertitude pour rendre l’IA utilisable, auditable et vraiment opérationnelle dans les décisions industrielles liées aux risques. https://postgenai.sorbonne-universite.fr/pac/cap-1.6 Bien qu’il existe un nombre de solutions important (méthodes locales, méthodes globales (Carvalho et al., 2024)), une marge de progression est encore nécessaire sur les taux de fausses alarmes. Les premières constatations issues de l’étude benchmark sur AutoVI montrent que pour des défauts logiques (des câblages par exemple) le taux de fausses alarmes est compris entre 5% et 20%. Il est donc primordial d’apporter de nouvelles méthodes aidant à expliquer les raisons d’une fausse activation. Par conséquent, un verrou attaqué dans ce projet concerne la réduction des taux de fausses alarmes et l'amélioration de l'explicabilité des résultats pour les images incorrectement classées comme défectueuses

Organisés en équipes de télévente, ils prennent en charge les leads, qualifient les projets, réalisent les études solaires et pilotent la vente à distance jusqu'à la signature . 3 Technico-Commerciaux terrain , encadrés par 1 Team Leader, réalisent les visites techniques chez les particuliers avec un double rôle : valider la faisabilité technique du projet et contribuer activement à la vente . Le/la Sales Manager manage directement ces 3 Team Leaders , ainsi qu'une équipe marketing. Le poste est basé à Paris et implique des déplacements réguliers à Lille pour rester proche des équipes et du terrain. Ta mission :  En tant que Sales Manager, tu es responsable de la performance commerciale de l'activité Services, de la prise en charge du lead jusqu'à la vente , sur nos différentes offres : installations photovoltaïques avec ou sans batterie, batteries seules et bornes de recharge. Ton rôle est à la fois managérial, opérationnel et entrepreneurial : faire progresser les équipes, améliorer continuellement notre modèle de vente et construire les process et outils nécessaires à notre croissance.   Manager et développer les équipes : Manager et accompagner tes N-1 dans le pilotage quotidien de leurs équipes. Être un manager proche du terrain : écouter les appels, analyser les rendez-vous, comprendre les objections clients. Développer une culture forte du coaching commercial et de l'amélioration continue, et faire progresser les équipes sur les techniques de télévente, la connaissance produit et les outils. Piloter le funnel commercial et les taux de conversion à chaque étape ; construire un forecast fiable. Agir sur les leviers du coût d'acquisition : conversion, productivité des équipes, organisation du parcours de vente, dimensionnement de l'équipe. Interview with your future manager to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role

jobs.title: Grafikdesigner – Social Ads / Performance Creatives (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Mission Bevor du weiterliest: Diese Stelle ist bewusst nicht für alle geschrieben. Bei uns hast du sehr viel Freiheit. Wir kontrollieren nicht, wann du wie arbeitest, sondern was am Ende rauskommt. Diese Freiheit bekommst du aber nur mit Verantwortung: für deine Projekte, für deine Deadlines und für die Ergebnisse unserer Kunden. Teamwork steht bei uns an erster Stelle. Wir helfen uns gegenseitig, springen füreinander ein und liefern gemeinsam richtig geile Arbeit ab. Das funktioniert nur, wenn alle mitziehen. Wer das nicht tut, mit dem trennen wir uns konsequent, spätestens in der Probezeit. Das ist nicht böse gemeint, wir schulden es dem Rest des Teams. Wenn du einen gemütlichen Job suchst, spar dir und uns die Zeit. Bewirb dich nur, wenn du glaubst, dass du unser Team wirklich ergänzt, und die Ambitionen mitbringst, zu den Besten zu gehören. Wir sind ein Office-First-Team im Herzen Münchens und setzen auf enge Zusammenarbeit, starke Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Lieferqualität ohne Kompromisse. Lies die Ausschreibung bitte bis zum Ende, das ist schon Teil der Bewerbung. Du denkst in Hooks, nicht nur in Moodboards. Du weißt, dass eine Static Ad in unter zwei Sekunden entscheidet, ob jemand stoppt oder weiterscrollt, und genau dafür gestaltest du. In unserem Grafik-Team entwickelst du Statics, Carousels und ganze Ad-Serien für E-Commerce und DTC Brands auf Meta, TikTok und Google. Die sollen nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern messbar verkaufen. Du arbeitest eng mit Creative Strategy und dem Performance-Team zusammen, siehst die Zahlen deiner Creatives und nutzt sie, um das nächste Creative noch besser zu machen. Konkret Du gestaltest Static Ads, Carousels und Ad-Varianten für Meta (Feed, Story, Reels), TikTok und Google auf Basis unserer Creative Briefings. Du übersetzt Hooks, Angles und Offers in Layouts, die im Feed sofort funktionieren: klare Hierarchie, auf dem Handy lesbar, Produkt im Fokus. Du baust schnell und sauber Iterationen von Winner-Ads: neue Hooks, Formate, Visuals, Farbwelten. Du arbeitest innerhalb der Brand Guidelines und weißt, wann du sie im Sinne der Performance dehnen kannst. Du arbeitest eng mit Motion und Video zusammen und lieferst Dateien, die direkt animiert werden können. Du setzt KI-Tools (z. B. Firefly, Generative Fill, Midjourney) gezielt für Compositing, Freisteller und Szenen ein, ohne dass das Ergebnis nach KI aussieht. Du organisierst deine Projekte selbstständig und lieferst zuverlässig pünktlich. Dein Profil Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Grafikdesigner, davon nachweislich mit Social Ads oder Performance Creatives (Agentur oder In-house bei einer E-Commerce Brand). Sicher in Photoshop, Illustrator und Figma. Ein starkes Portfolio mit echten, live geschalteten Ads. Reine Branding-, Print- oder Uni-Projekte reichen für diese Rolle nicht. Sehr gutes Gespür für Typografie, Layout, Farbe und Bildbearbeitung (Retusche, Compositing, Freisteller). Du kennst die Ad-Formate (1:1, 4:5, 9:16) und Safe Zones und weißt, wie ein Static im Feed wirken muss. Du weißt, was CTR, Hook Rate und ROAS bedeuten, und willst verstehen, warum ein Creative gewinnt. Du arbeitest schnell und bleibst trotzdem pixelgenau, auch bei der 20. Variante. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (in Wort und Schrift). Lebensmittelpunkt München (unverzichtbar). Wir setzen auf Office-First. Diese Rolle ist NICHT für dich, wenn: Du um Punkt 18:00 Uhr den Laptop zuklappst. Du Ads für die kleine Schwester von „echtem“ Design hältst. Du an deinem Design festhältst, obwohl die Zahlen etwas anderes sagen. Du für jede Variante erst eine Woche Inspiration brauchst. Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn: Du Ads im Feed nicht wegscrollst, sondern screenshottest und zerlegst. Du Bock hast, dass deine Arbeit an echten Zahlen gemessen wird. Du schnell iterierst und aus jedem Test etwas mitnimmst. Du den Ehrgeiz hast, zu den Besten in deinem Fach zu gehören. Du mit einem preisgekrönten Design & Motion Team wachsen möchtest. jobs.description: Senior Product Designer @ Secfix Location: Remote (EMEA) · CET/CEST time zone Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix. Our founding product designer, Ghada , has been doing exactly that since we started. The engineering team has doubled, and we're shipping faster than we ever have. We're hiring the third designer because there's more good work to do than two people can handle — and we'd rather ship faster than slow down. What we believe Compliance software has historically been built like the audit it automates — heavy, defensive, ugly. We're building something else. The customer is a real person trying to ship audit-ready evidence on a Friday afternoon. The product should respect their time, automate the boring parts, and make the rest feel calm. Quality is the product. Most of our category competes on feature lists. We compete on craft. A clear empty state, a sync that doesn't lie, a settings page that holds together at eleven permission tiers — these are the things customers feel before they can name them. Design at Secfix is not what wraps the product. It's most of what makes it work. What the role is We expect strong design skills, strong product thinking, and the ability to hold your own in a technical discussion. Collect pricing data and set price assessments in line with the company’s methodology, price specifications and principles, and IOSCO principles Write market commentaries, breaking news and insightful copy with price reporting angles Back colleagues up on their pricing patches to provide cover and consistency for the market and build up a wider knowledge base Peer review prices to verify that processes have been followed and editorial judgement applied correctly to ensure our prices are representative Manage and expand the number of industry contacts that submit pricing data and give news exclusives Handle questions from contacts and the market about the dynamics of particular pricing sessions, seeking guidance when inquiries are sensitive Help foster Fastmarkets ’ prices and expertise through the team’s market engagement plans Present at events and webinars, and chair panel discussions when deemed appropriate by editors on behalf of the company We are looking for: A high level of written and spoken Spanish and English is necessary. An interest in and understanding of financial markets and commodities Pricing experience is helpful, but is not required Journalistic reporting experience is helpful, but is not required Strong networking and communication skills, confident telephone manner Team player who fosters excellent working culture and acts - both internally and externally - in a courteous and professional manner, with impeccable integrity Ability to work with numbers and spreadsheets and produce analytical editorial copy Ability to undertake business travel by plane, train or car We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully. If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on. KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and have a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player is also important as well as someone who is happy to work flexibly. If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway. Our Values Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values. Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are: METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done GROWTH MINDSET . This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day. CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspective

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description: The Senior Business Analyst is an expert in business analysis, functional design, and web solutions. They contribute to the evolution and modernization of LGI's Human Resources (HR) and Payroll management solutions by transforming business needs into digital solutions that create value for customers and end users. Working closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Developers, Subject Matter Experts, and customers, the Senior Business Analyst participates in every stage of the Agile development lifecycle, from product discovery through feature delivery. They play a key role in modernizing the web components of LGI's HR and Payroll solutions by designing functional solutions that are consistent, high-performing, and user-centered. As a subject matter expert, the Senior Business Analyst acts as a strategic partner to the Product teams. They facilitate discovery workshops, translate business needs into functional solutions, define expected application behaviors, and ensure that delivered functionality meets both business objectives and user needs. They leverage artificial intelligence tools to improve the efficiency of business analysis, prototyping, functional design, user story creation, and documentation. They also contribute to the evolution of business analysis practices by integrating AI tools as productivity enablers, proposing improvements to working methods, and promoting the adoption of best practices and emerging technologies. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Business Analysis & Functional Design (Approximately 65%) Collaborate with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Subject Matter Experts, and stakeholders to understand, analyze, and refine business requirements. Participate in Product Discovery activities, hypothesis validation, and user needs exploration. Contribute to the modernization of the HR and Payroll web solutions by participating in their functional design and ongoing evolution. Define user journeys, functional behaviors, business rules, validations, exception handling, and interactions between solution components. Partner with UI/UX Designers to design, refine, and validate wireframes and prototypes, ensuring alignment with business requirements and the desired user experience. Translate business requirements and design mockups into clear, complete user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation that are ready for development. Break down features into deliverable increments and contribute to prioritization based on business value, user experience, risk, and implementation complexity. Participate in the functional modernization of solutions by assessing the business, operational, and technical impacts of proposed changes. Responsibly leverage artificial intelligence tools to accelerate analysis, research, prototyping, documentation, and user story development while exercising critical judgment and ensuring the quality of deliverables. Communication & Collaboration (Approximately 25%) Work closely with Product Managers to ensure the consistent evolution of the product backlog. Participate in Agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Facilitate discovery, validation, and solution design workshops with customers and stakeholders. Present proposed functional solutions to stakeholders and obtain alignment and buy-in. Communicate business requirements and proposed solutions effectively to multidisciplinary teams. Support development teams by answering functional questions and validating deliverables prior to acceptance. Collaborate with Quality Assurance teams to define test scenarios. Maintain clear, accurate, and up-to-date functional documentation throughout the development lifecycle. Support implementation and Customer Success teams during the rollout of new functionality. jobs.title: IT Help Desk | End-User Support
jobs.description: Are you passionate about helping people solve technical problems and keeping systems running smoothly? We're looking for a Client Technologies Technician to be the friendly, knowledgeable front line of an IT Help Desk supporting a fast-paced professional environment. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys troubleshooting, working directly with users, and being the go-to resource when technology challenges arise. As a Client Technologies Technician, you'll serve as the first point of contact for IT support, delivering prompt, professional assistance while ensuring systems and users stay productive. Key responsibilities include: Answering, documenting, and triaging help desk requests via phone, email, and chat Resolving common issues such as password resets, account unlocks, and connectivity problems Managing user accounts, access rights, and deactivations in enterprise systems Escalating complex issues to the appropriate technical teams Maintaining IT knowledge base content and self-service resources Assisting users with general computer and software questions Managing loaner equipment, peripherals, and IT inventory Supporting audits, inventories, and team improvement initiatives Ensuring compliance with data security and confidentiality requirements CONTRACTOR QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE: 2+ years of experience in a help desk or service desk environment Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and common desktop technologies Hands-on experience troubleshooting hardware, software, and user access issues Clear communicator who can explain technical concepts to non-technical users Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a structured environment Ability to pass a background screening Why This Role? Stable, long-term engagement in a mission-driven environment Hands-on exposure to a wide range of IT support activities Opportunity to make a measurable impact improving user experience Collaborative team setting with room to grow your technical skill set Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) - Springfield, OH
jobs.description: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner ( PMHNP-BC ) $125k - $145k/year Position Requirement: Full - Time FLSA Status: Exempt Location: Springfield, Ohio Salary: 125K - 145K+ Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities! Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency. OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of: · Competitive Salary · Medical benefits · Paid malpractice policy · CEU reimbursement · Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays · Productivity Bonuses in select areas · Work-Life Balance · Flexible Work Schedule No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients! It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure. Work from or close to home: With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available. Responsibilities: The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve. Customize the care for each patient: Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients. Pick your own schedule! Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance. Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM. Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer (Full-Stack, Automation-Heavy)
jobs.description: Why Altium Software Engineering? Renesas 365 (R365) is a new cloud platform for electronics system design, combining hardware and software workflows. The domain involves complex data relationships and system-level interactions. Altium offers the opportunity to conceive and build new product features for electronics engineers, and add your own ideas to the world’s most collaborative and efficient electronics design platform. About the Role This is a full-stack QA role focused on test automation and feature coverage. Please note: This is not an AQA (Automation QA) role — test frameworks are maintained by a dedicated AQA team. A Day in the Life of Our Senior QA Engineer Own feature quality end-to-end (UI + API) Write automated tests using existing tools: Selenium WebDriver Reqnroll (BDD) Playwright (growing direction) Ensure full test coverage of features Maintain and extend automated scenarios Participate in regression and release testing Work with CI pipelines (run/debug tests) Collaborate with AQA team on framework usage What We’re Looking For 4+ years of experience as a QA Engineer Experience in automated testing using existing frameworks Ability to write and understand test code (C# is preferrable) Experience testing web applications (UI + API) Understanding of test design and coverage Experience with CI/CD and Git Nice to have Experience with Playwright Experience with GraphQL APIs Experience in EDA / electronics / CAD domains Experience in desktop application testing Originally posted on Himalayas
